fact: INTIC said the proposed National AI Strategy was in its final phase with provincial public consultations under way, to be reviewed by a multisectoral working group and submitted to the Council of Ministers after the technical component is completed by June 2026.
title: Moçambique Apresenta Draft da Estratégia Nacional de Inteligência Artificial em Workshop Internacional da ITU no Quénia
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação (INTIC)
